blocks.text:
Spend the next few days relaxing on the beach. Sunbathe, swim in the warm water and choose activities to suit your mood: snorkelling, windsurfing, water skiing or kayaking.

Local restaurants serve fresh fish, which you can enjoy with a caipirinha or freshly squeezed fruit juice. For a more active day, hire a buggy and explore the peninsula's different beaches.

Another option is a sailing trip with stops out at sea for swimming and exploring the underwater world.

You can choose another Brazilian resort for the beach part of your trip instead of Búzios. Angra dos Reis, about 155 km south of Rio de Janeiro, suits travellers who prefer quiet surroundings and nature.

In north-eastern Brazil, options include Porto de Galinhas, Pipa, Salvador, Jericoacoara, Aquiraz, Porto Seguro and Trancoso. The flight from Rio takes about 2–3 hours. These resorts suit travellers who enjoy long beaches and clear water. The ocean there is often warmer and calmer.
